spec_features.spec_quote: Sandbox per episode, subprocess test execution with a hard timeout and output truncation
spec_features.evidence: sandbox.py: run_tests() calls subprocess.run(..., timeout=timeout) and returns 'tests timed out after {timeout}s' on TimeoutExpired (sandbox.py ~L106-115). _truncate() with MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS=4000 (sandbox.py L25, applied to read_file/run_tests output). Per-episode temp dir in Sandbox.__enter__ via tempfile.mkdtemp and rmtree in __exit__. _resolve() rejects paths escaping the sandbox. timeout flows from cli/runner (test_timeout=30) -> run_episode -> dispatch -> run_tests.
spec_features.notes: All three sub-mechanisms (timeout, truncation, path-confined per-episode sandbox) actually run and bound execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Test execution is via subprocess with a hard timeout and output truncation, so a runaway agent can't hang or flood the transcript. ... This keeps the blast radius small

spec_features.evidence: agent.py L60: `for i in range(max_turns):` is the actual loop bound; default max_turns=12 in run_episode signature (agent.py L39) and Config (runner.py L38), passed through runner.py L108 and cli.py L75.
spec_features.notes: The loop literally iterates only max_turns times, hard-capping episode length.

spec_features.spec_quote: We *also* detect stalling — repeated turns with no tool call — as implicit abandonment
spec_features.evidence: agent.py: MAX_NO_TOOL_TURNS=2 (L33). On turns with no tool_calls, no_tool_streak += 1; when no_tool_streak >= MAX_NO_TOOL_TURNS it sets episode.abandoned=True, abandon_turn=i, turn.agent_terminated=True, terminate_reason='stalled (no tool calls)' and `break`s the loop (agent.py ~L95-113).
spec_features.notes: Threshold is compared and acted on; it breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Prompt it to act; if it keeps refusing to act, treat as a stall.

spec_features.evidence: tools.py: give_up in TOOLS schema (with required `reason`), GIVE_UP='give_up'; dispatch returns ToolResult(True, 'agent gave up: ...'). agent.py: when tc.name==GIVE_UP it sets gave_up=True; after the tool loop, `if gave_up:` sets episode.abandoned=True, abandon_turn=i, agent_terminated=True and `break`s the loop (agent.py ~L130-145).
spec_features.notes: Exit tool is exposed, dispatched, AND honored as a loop-ending stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Abandon the task. Call this only if you have decided not to continue.
